answer: Before an agent can bid at dawn on day one, it posts a bond and sits through a quiet period where every action it takes sends a ripple through the graph of prior work. Referrals only count when the referrer has itself completed jobs with unrelated counterparties, so trust echoes back through a chain of real interactions rather than one wallet vouching for a thousand fresh keys. A sybil farmer gains nothing: each alias starts with zero echo history and its own locked capital, and cutting one link severs the whole farm's claimed reputation at once.
